semiconductor_relevance: High — MPI Corporation is a key player in the semiconductor testing sector, providing advanced probe card technologies and test solutions for various semiconductor applications.
summary: MPI Corporation specializes in testing solutions for semiconductors, including advanced probe cards and thermal test systems. With a focus on high-precision probing and measurement, they support a wide range of applications from R&D to volume production.
capabilities: Probe card technologies for wafer-level testing
High-precision probing solutions for RF and mixed-signal applications
Thermal test systems for semiconductor devices
Test & measurement software for calibration and inspection

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, MPI Corporation has a strong presence in the semiconductor testing market.
